method: Read primary standards and exact installed tool source only; no alternate validator or efficacy run

sourceFragment.description:
The image data for the image manifest.
This field is only populated when Kind is "image".

Platform.description:
OCI platform of the image. This will be the platform specified in the
manifest descriptor from the index/manifest list.
If it's not available, it will be obtained from the image config.

Containers.description: The IDs of the containers that are using this image.

Unpacked.description:
Unpacked is the size (in bytes) of the locally unpacked
(uncompressed) image content that's directly usable by the containers
running this image.
It's independent of the distributable content - e.g.
the image might still have an unpacked data that's still used by
some container even when the distributable/compressed content is
already gone.

validatorRule: Reject when set(schema.required) minus set(schema.properties.keys()) is nonempty, for non-allOf definitions.

primaryStandards.finding: required follows JSON Schema Draft4 unchanged; properties/additionalProperties keep their semantics with Schema Object references.
required constrains key presence in instances; it does not require corresponding entries under properties. Additional properties remain allowed unless restricted.

inference: Absence of a property declaration can be an authoring inconsistency but is not by itself a violation of Draft4 required semantics. This does not adjudicate every other schema constraint or live-response behavior.
